title: Total sales
context: The most basic measure on the model.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount.
hint: Reach for the basic aggregation that adds up a column.

title: Total cost
context: Finance needs the total cost of goods.
task: Write a measure for total CostAmount.
hint: Same aggregation as a sales total, on the cost column.

title: Total quantity
context: How many units were sold in all?
task: Write a measure for the total units sold (the Quantity column).
hint: Add up the quantity column.

title: Number of sales
context: How many transaction lines are in the fact table?
task: Write a measure that returns the number of rows in Sales.
hint: There's a function that counts the rows of an entire table.

title: Average quantity
context: Typical units per line.
task: Write a measure for the average units per sales line.
hint: The mean of the quantity column.

title: Average sale amount
context: Typical line value.
task: Write a measure for the average SalesAmount per line.
hint: The mean of the sales amount column.

title: Largest single sale
context: The biggest line amount on record.
task: Write a measure for the largest single SalesAmount.
hint: The maximum of the sales amount column.

title: Smallest sale
context: The smallest line amount on record.
task: Write a measure for the smallest single SalesAmount.
hint: The minimum of the sales amount column.

title: Distinct customers
context: How many different customers have bought?
task: Write a measure for the number of distinct customers in Sales.
hint: Count the unique values of the customer key, not the rows.

title: Distinct products sold
context: How broad is the product mix that actually sells?
task: Write a measure for the number of distinct products that appear in Sales.
hint: Count unique product keys.

title: Gross profit
context: Profit before any allocations.
task: Write a measure for gross profit: total sales minus total cost.
hint: Subtract one running total from another.

title: Average revenue per sale
context: Revenue spread over the number of transactions.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount divided by the number of sales lines. Use safe division so an empty table doesn't error.
hint: Use the division function that handles a zero/blank denominator gracefully.

title: Profit margin
context: Profit as a share of revenue.
task: Write a measure for profit margin: (sales minus cost) as a fraction of sales. Use safe division.
hint: Put gross profit over total sales, guarding the divide.

title: Quantity values recorded
context: COUNT tallies non-blank numeric values (unlike COUNTROWS).
task: Write a measure for how many non-blank Quantity values are recorded.
hint: Count the numeric values in one column, not the table rows.

title: Electronics sales
context: Category managers want their slice of the total.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount limited to the Electronics product category.
hint: Take the sales total and apply a category filter to it — the function that changes filter context.

title: Furniture sales
context: Another single-category total.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount limited to the Furniture category.
hint: Same pattern as any single-category total: filter the sum by category.

title: North region sales
context: Filter by a customer attribute rather than a product one.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount from customers in the North region.
hint: Filter the sales total by a column on the Customer table.

title: Corporate segment sales
context: Segment-level revenue.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount from the Corporate customer segment.
hint: Filter the total by the customer segment.

title: Sales in 2024
context: A single-year total, filtered through the Date table.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount in the year 2024.
hint: Filter the total by the Year column on the Date table.

title: Sales in 2023
context: The prior-year comparison total.
task: Write a measure for total SalesAmount in the year 2023.
hint: Same as the current-year total, filtered to the earlier year.

title: Sales size label
context: A card should read 'Big' or 'Small' depending on the total.
task: Write a measure that returns 'Big' when total SalesAmount exceeds 500000, otherwise 'Small'.
hint: A conditional that compares the running total to a threshold and returns text.

title: Electronics product count
context: How many SKUs sit in one category?
task: Write a measure for the number of products in the Electronics category (count a filtered Product table).
hint: Count the rows of the Product table after narrowing it to one category.

title: Revenue via row iteration
context: Compute revenue line by line instead of from a stored column.
task: Write a measure for net revenue by iterating Sales: quantity times the product's price times (1 − discount).
hint: Use a row-by-row iterator; pull the price from the related Product row.

title: List-price revenue
context: What revenue would be at full list price (no discounts)?
task: Write a measure iterating Sales of quantity times the product's list price, ignoring discount.
hint: Same iterator as net revenue, without the discount factor.

title: Cost via row iteration
context: Rebuild cost from the product table to sanity-check the stored CostAmount.
task: Write a measure iterating Sales of quantity times the product's cost.
hint: Iterate the fact table and pull cost from the related Product row.

title: Average product markup
context: Markup per product, averaged across the catalogue.
task: Write a measure for the average of (price − cost) across products.
hint: Iterate the Product table and average the per-row markup.

title: Priciest product
context: The highest list price in the catalogue.
task: Write a measure for the maximum product price across the Product table.
hint: Use the iterator form of max over the Product table.

title: Discounted sales count
context: How often do we actually discount?
task: Write a measure for the number of sales lines that carried a discount (Discount greater than 0).
hint: Count the rows of Sales after keeping only discounted lines.
